title: Integrability and measurability lift from A to the slab over A
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k], L¹ := Lebesgue measure on ℝ, Φ(s, x) := (s, x_1, …, x_P) ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons s (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ x))), Φ′(p) := Φ(p.1, p.2) for p ∈ ℝ × ℝ^P, π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))) and y₀ := (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y) 0. Assume (MP): for every A ⊆ ℝ^P that is Hᵐ-null-measurable, countably m-rectifiable and has Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, H^{m+1}⌞{y : π(y) ∈ A} = Φ′_*(L¹ ⊗ Hᵐ⌞A). Let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Hᵐ-null-measurable and countably m-rectifiable with Hᵐ(A ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K, and put S_A := {y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} : π(y) ∈ A ∧ y₀ ∈ (0, 1)}. Then (a) for every f : ℝ^P → ℝ that is Hᵐ-integrable on A, the function y ↦ f(π(y)) is H^{m+1}-integrable on S_A; and (b) for every g : ℝ^P → Λ_m(ℝ^P) (NVector (Eucl P) m) that is (Hᵐ⌞A)-a.e. strongly measurable, the function y ↦ g(π(y)) is (H^{m+1}⌞S_A)-a.e. strongly measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A} = Measure.map (fun p : ℝ × Eucl P => (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ).symm (Fin.cons p.1 (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ p.2))) ((volume : Measure ℝ).prod ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A))) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → CountablyRectifiable m A → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) (A ∩ K) < ∞) → (∀ f : Eucl P → ℝ, IntegrableOn f A (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → IntegrableOn (fun y : Eucl (P + 1) => f ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)))) {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A ∧ EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1} (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1)))) ∧ ∀ g : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) m, AEStronglyMeasurable g ((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun y : Eucl (P + 1) => g ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)))) ((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))).restrict {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ A ∧ EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y 0 ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1})
